The shoe is easy to slip on and off, making it perfect for quick and convenient wear. The Oalise is available in both medium and wide widths, accommodating various foot sizes. The affordable price point makes it a great value purchase that you will love to wear every day. The timeless and versatile design of the Oalise makes it a perfect addition to any wardrobe. AK Anne Klein offers an impressive footwear collection offering unparalleled variety in an extensive range of sizes, colors, and styles that give each shoe a unique style and character.
